name: Giga.Green
funFact: Giga.Green's stated mission is to save one gigaton (one billion tons) of CO2, which is where its name comes from.

sources.quote: Founded in 2018 by Sebastian Schmidt and Wolfgang Röbig, GIGA.GREEN is a leading German renewable energy solutions provider for commercial clients.
Founded in 2018 by Sebastian Schmidt and Wolfgang Röbig
GIGA.GREEN designs, develops, and operates commercial solar energy systems, battery storage, and charging infrastructure in Germany.
GIGA.GREEN has successfully completed a strategic growth financing round, securing EUR 25 million in equity from Ichigo Inc.
Giga.green's mission is to partner with its customers to save one gigaton (one billion tons) of CO2.
